title: Seaside "The Truman House" 31 Natchez street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Iconic home used in Jim Carrey’s The Truman Show- Walking distance to the beach- In the heart of Seaside near shops and restaurants- Gulf-view observation deck- Wraparound deck on the first floor- Community Pool- 4 adult bikes- ADA Wheelchair Accessible Entryway Ramp (No ADA Showers)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Step into cinematic history at The Truman House—a timeless coastal property, famously featured in Jim Carrey’s The Truman Show! Situated in the heart of Seaside, only 1 block from the beach, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers 2,136 square feet of luxurious living space, thoughtfully accommodating 10 guests in comfort and style. Seaside’s walkable community invites leisurely days meandering Ruskin Place’s galleries and boutiques, grabbing a bite at the vintage Airstream food trucks, or lounging on the sugar-soft sands. After exploring, soak in sweeping Gulf views from the home’s observation deck!Iconic and instantly recognizable, this 2-story cottage—still bearing its original movie house number “36”—sets the stage for a bright, carefree escape. From the cheerful butter yellow and sherbet orange trim to the vivid green front door (where Truman delivered the famous line, “Good morning, and in case I don’t see ya—good afternoon, good evening, and good night!”) every detail captures its whimsical appeal. Step onto the screened front porch, where guests can enjoy a fragrant cup of coffee while the overhead fan produces a peaceful breeze. Inside, the home opens into a breathtaking living space with gleaming hardwood floors and a show-stopping cathedral ceiling. Comfy wicker and slip-covered furnishings beckon guests to unwind with the latest beach read or gather over glasses of chilled wine. A decorative tile fireplace separates the living space from the 8-seat dining table and gourmet kitchen, featuring premium appliances and an expansive island that doubles as a breakfast bar for 3. Behind the French doors is a washer and dryer, perfect for refreshing beach gear. Outside, a lovely wraparound deck with gorgeous tree shade offers plenty of room for picnic blankets or yoga flows. The charm continues into 2 beautiful guest bedrooms, each with a queen bed and private bathroom, alongside a kid-friendly bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed.The second floor welcomes families to unwind in a generously sized guest bedroom, featuring a queen bed, connected twin-over-twin bunk area, cozy play space, and TV. Step onto the rooftop balcony, where stairs lead up to the crow’s nest, offering sweeping Gulf views.Experience Seaside like never before at The Truman House, a dream destination for fans! With on-site parking and 4 complimentary bikes, explore other film locations like the Seaside Amphitheater, Tupelo Street Gazebo, and more. For beach access, follow Natchez Street past 30A to the Natchez Beach Pavilion. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and XL Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.
